title: Philippine Constitution & Political Science Review
description: A comprehensive 25-item quiz covering the 1987 Philippine Constitution, branches of government, civil liberties, electoral systems, and political theory with situational analysis and data interpretation

questions.questionText: The 1987 Philippine Constitution was ratified on February 2, 1987 through a plebiscite, replacing the 1973 Constitution.

A barangay captain is running for congressman in the upcoming elections. He files his Certificate of Candidacy (COC) six months before election day. Under Article VI of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is true regarding his eligibility?

options.text: He is eligible as long as he resigns from his barangay post before election day
He is eligible because local officials are exempt from the restriction on candidacy
He is considered resigned from his barangay position upon filing of his COC under the Omnibus Election Code
He must wait for the end of his term before filing a COC for a higher position

questions.questionText: Under the 1987 Constitution, the President of the Philippines serves a term of _____ years and is _____ for reelection.
Review the composition of the Philippine Legislature table. Under the party-list system, how many seats are reserved for party-list representatives in the House of Representatives?

options.text: 20% of the total membership of the House
25% of the total membership of the House
1/3 of the total membership of the House

questions.questionText: In political science, Montesquieu's doctrine of separation of powers divides government into three branches. Which of the following correctly maps the three branches in the Philippine government?

options.text: Executive – President; Legislative – Congress; Judicial – Supreme Court
Executive – Senate; Legislative – President; Judicial – COMELEC
Executive – Congress; Legislative – Cabinet; Judicial – Ombudsman
Executive – President; Legislative – Supreme Court; Judicial – Congress

questions.questionText: A senator was convicted by the Sandiganbayan for plunder, a heinous crime. Under Article XI of the 1987 Constitution on Accountability of Public Officers, which statement is correct?

options.text: The senator shall be removed from office and disqualified from holding any public office
The senator retains the position until impeached separately by the House
The senator may appeal to the President for executive clemency before removal
The senator forfeits pay but may complete the remaining term

questions.questionText: The writ of habeas corpus may be suspended by the President in cases of invasion or rebellion when public safety requires it, but Congress may revoke such suspension by a vote of at least _____ of all its members voting jointly.
Under Article VII of the 1987 Constitution, the President may declare martial law for a period not exceeding 60 days. Martial law automatically extends for another 60 days unless lifted by Congress.

A political scientist is analyzing seat distribution after a national election. The party-list formula used by COMELEC follows the Panganiban Formula derived from Banat v. COMELEC. Using the principle that the total party-list seats must not exceed 20% of the total House membership, if the total House has 300 seats, the maximum number of party-list seats is: $$\text{Party-list seats} = \frac{20}{100} \times 300$$
Review the table of Constitutional Commissions. Which commission is primarily responsible for conducting elections in the Philippines?
tableData: Oversees civil service and public employees

questions.questionText: Under the 1987 Constitution, the Bill of Rights is found in _____ of the Constitution.

A citizen is arrested without a warrant during a warrantless arrest in flagrante delicto. He demands to know the charges and be provided with counsel. Under Section 12, Article III of the 1987 Constitution (Rights of the Accused), which of the following rights is MOST directly applicable?

options.text: Right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel, preferably of his own choice
Right to bail in all criminal cases without exception
Right to be released immediately as the arrest was warrantless
Right to trial by jury as provided under the Bill of Rights

questions.questionText: The principle of checks and balances means that each branch of government has the power to limit or control the actions of the other branches.

In computing voter turnout as a percentage of registered voters, the formula is: $$\text{Voter Turnout (\%)} = \frac{\text{Total Votes Cast}}{\text{Total Registered Voters}} \times 100$$ In a barangay election, 3,450 out of 5,000 registered voters cast their ballots. What is the voter turnout percentage?

A newly-elected mayor wants to pass a local ordinance banning a specific religious group from conducting worship activities in public parks. Under Article III, Section 5 of the 1987 Constitution, this ordinance is:

options.text: Unconstitutional — it violates the free exercise clause and non-establishment of religion
Constitutional — local government units have police power over public spaces
Valid only if approved by COMELEC and the Sangguniang Panlalawigan
Constitutional because public parks are government property

questions.questionText: Review the comparison of Philippine Constitutions below. Which constitution is associated with the Marcos dictatorship?
tableData: Established bicameral legislature, set path to independence
Shifted to parliamentary system; extended executive power
Transitional constitution after People Power Revolution
Restored presidential system; strong Bill of Rights

questions.questionText: The Supreme Court of the Philippines is composed of a Chief Justice and _____ Associate Justices.

A political analyst computes the Effective Number of Parties (ENP) using the Laakso-Taagepera index: $$ENP = \frac{1}{\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i^2}$$ where $p_i$ is the seat share of party $i$. If three parties hold seat shares of 0.50, 0.30, and 0.20 respectively, the ENP is approximately _____ (round to two decimal places).

Under the Local Government Code (RA 7160), the principle of local autonomy means that local government units (LGUs) are completely independent of the national government and not subject to any national supervision.

A city councilor files a resolution proposing that the city's annual budget allocate at least 20% to infrastructure. Under the 1987 Constitution and the Local Government Code, the annual budget of an LGU must allocate at least _____ of its Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) to development fund projects.
The power of judicial review — the authority of the Supreme Court to declare laws or acts unconstitutional — is explicitly stated in the 1987 Constitution.

An election analyst calculates the margin of victory using: $$\text{Margin (\%)} = \frac{\text{Winning Votes} - \text{Runner-up Votes}}{\text{Total Votes Cast}} \times 100$$ In a senatorial race, Candidate A receives 18,500,000 votes and Candidate B receives 15,200,000 votes out of 40,000,000 total votes cast. What is the margin of victory?

A congressman introduces a bill raising the income tax rate for the highest bracket. Under Article VI of the 1987 Constitution, all appropriation, revenue, and tariff bills must originate exclusively from the:
Review the comparison of political ideologies below. Which ideology most closely aligns with the principle that the state should own the means of production for collective benefit?

A governor declares a state of calamity in the province after a major typhoon. Funds are to be released from the local calamity fund. Under the Local Government Code, what percentage of the estimated revenue from regular sources must be appropriated as the annual Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (LDRRM) Fund?
